headline: Fear And Greed Rose To 63 From Neutral At 53
narrative: The crypto fear and greed index rose to 63, Greed, from 53, Neutral, in the latest print. The index is a sentiment pipe that tracks how warm or cold the crowd is, not cash moving through a fund or an exchange, and the rise returned the reading to greed after a single neutral print. The print before that neutral mark was greed at 62, and the new reading sits one point above it.
author: jordan
